SL-004 is implemented and committed as `34c5a95`. `npm test` passes (23 of 23, including the 7 new SL-004 tests) and `npm run typecheck` is clean. - **Backend (`src/tasks.ts`, `src/app.ts`):** - Title validation trims the title, then rejects it if it isn't a string, is empty or spaces only, or is over 500 characters. Exactly 500 after trimming is accepted. - Rejected requests get a 400 `validation_failed` with the exact messages from `contracts/tasks-api.md`, and nothing is stored. - A malformed JSON body now returns 400 `invalid_json`. The slice didn't ask for this, but the contract lists it and it was a one-line catch. - **Frontend (`public/index.html`, `public/app.js`):** a `

` shows the server's `error.message` when a submit is rejected. On success the message is cleared, and the input is cleared only then, so the owner can correct a rejected title and resubmit. - **Database layer:** untouched, as the slice requires. - **Tests (`tests/tasks.test.ts`):** they cover empty, spaces-only, non-string, 501-character, trimmed-500-character and invalid-JSON requests, plus the presence of the page's message element. The frontend behavior is only checked as page and script content, because the test setup has no browser. I didn't run the page in a browser. I didn't change the slice file's `status` or `.sddpp/active.json`. Earlier slices were closed in separate commits that also touched the planning documents, so I left that step to you.
